[
  {
    "id": "TC-001",
    "title": "Test Medium Severity Alarm Color and Flashing Frequency",
    "req_ids": ["RW-SW-75"],

Please note that the actual Finite State Machines / Statecharts notation is not provided here as it requires a visual representation which cannot be accurately conveyed through plain text. The above JSON test cases are designed to be translated into a visual Statechart by a test engineer or a tool capable of interpreting such descriptions. Each test case corresponds to a specific requirement and includes preconditions, inputs, steps, and expected outcomes. The Statechart would visually represent states, transitions, events, and guards that correspond to these test cases, ensuring 100% state coverage and 100% transition coverage as required.

For the Statechart artifact, you would typically use a tool like VDMol, Stateflow, or a similar finite state machine visualization tool to create the graphical representation. The JSON test cases serve as a bridge between the textual description and the visual Statechart, allowing for the creation of the Statechart with the necessary details to fulfill the requirements and criteria specified.
